newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indosat buys 13 pct stake in Pramindo.
newsitem.headline: Indosat buys 13 pct stake in Pramindo.

text.p: Indonesian telecommunications firm PT Indonesian Satellite Corporation (Indosat) has bought a 13 percent stake worth $57.2 million in telecommunications firm PT Pramindo Ikat Nusantara, the Jakarta stock exchange said in a statement.

"PT Indosat has signed an agreement to buy a 13-percent stake worth $57,200,000 in PT Pramindo Ikat Nusantara to strengthen its customer base in the Sumatra region," the exchange said in a statement received on Monday.

The 13-percent stake purchase included a 7.5 percent stake from privately-owned firm PT Astratel, 3.5 percent from PT Intertel Pratamamedia and two percent from cooperative Primkopparpostel, the statement said.

After the stake purchase, Pramindo Ikat stakeholders include PT Astratel with 40 percent, France Cables et Radio 35 percent, Indosat 13 percent, Marubeni Corporation eight percent, International Finance Corporation three percent and Nichimen Corporation one percent.
The statement did not give further details.
State-controlled Indosat is a diversified telecommunications firm with the core business of providing international telephone services.

Under a joint operating scheme with state owned PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia, Pramindo Ikat is responsible for the operation and installation of telephone lines in the Sumatra region. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
